page.overview:
Who is Denethor I?

Denethor I was the tenth Ruling Steward of Gondor.

Denethor I was born in TA 2375, Denethor I was the son of Rían, the sister of the ninth Ruling Steward Dior.

Following the death of his uncle in TA 2435 Denethor I became the tenth Ruling Steward of Gondor. Denethor I was the last Steward to rule during the era known as the Watchful Peace. After ruling Gondor peacefully for twenty five years, the Watchful Peace ended in TA 2460 with the return of Sauron to Dol Guldur. In TA 2475 Sauron's forces attacked Gondor, unleashing the dreaded Black Uruks, a new race of black Orcs heavier and stronger than any seen before. They destroyed Osgiliath and broke its great stone-bridge leaving it ruined and abandoned from then on. However, the Men of Gondor under the leadership of Denethor I's son Boromir recaptured Ithilien from Sauron's forces, and drove them back east of the river. Denethor I died two years later in the year TA 2477 at the age of 102 after a rule of forty-two years. He was succeeded by his son Boromir.

In Nandorin, the name Denethor means "Lithe-and-lank", from the words dene ("strong, lithe") and thara ("tall, slender").
